Reference / db/error

db/error#

Database errors.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

try { await db.execution("INSERT …", DbText(name)); }
catch DbFailure.detailed(kind, operation, code, message) {
    if kind == DbFailureKind.constraint { … }        // a unique key, say
}

Description#

Database errors.

Drivers map their errors to a DbFailureKind and keep the database's own code (SQLSTATE or SQLite code). Messages come from the database; SQL, bound values and connection strings never appear in them.

enum DbFailure#

enum DbFailure is Error = (detailed(kind is DbFailureKind, operation is DbOperation, code is string, message is string))

Provider-controlled diagnostics only. A caller supplying its own message is responsible for that explicit text; drivers never forward SQL/bindings/DSNs.
